item.title: Artemis, Returning to the Moon
item.dc:creator: chris
item.content:encoded:
Artemis, Greek goddess of the Moon, will follow in twin brother Apollo's footsteps, and return people to the Moon.

Beginning with the Artemis Accords in 2020, NASA and 7 other countries established the foundations to explore the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Since 2020 there has been much planning, research, and development. They planned the first 5 missions to hopefully begin building a Moon base.

Artemis I: Successfully completed as an uncrewed test flight of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft. It launched from Kennedy Space Center on November 16, 2022, and splashed down December 11, 2022.

Artemis II: Successfully completed first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972! It launched from Kennedy Space Center on April 1, 2026, and splashed down in the Pacific Ocean April 10, 2026. "The first crewed Artemis flight marks a key step toward long‑term return to the Moon and future missions to Mars." - NASA

Artemis III: Set to launch in 2027. NASA's Artemis III mission in low Earth orbit will test integrated operations between the Orion spacecraft and one or both commercial landers from SpaceX and Blue Origin respectively.

Artemis IV: Set to launch in 2028. Humanity's return to the lunar surface.

Artemis V: Set to launch in 2028.

item.title: The 2026 Hurricane Season
item.dc:creator: chris
item.content:encoded:
Philip's annual tweet says CSU calls for a below-normal season with 13 named storms, 6 hurricanes, and 2 major hurricanes. He adds that a “high likelihood of robust #ElNino and associated increases in vertical wind shear [are] the primary factor[s].”

NHC

References

  • From the National Hurricane Center, the 2026 Atlantic tropical cyclone names are: Arthur, Bertha, Cristobal, Dolly, Edouard, Fay, Gonzalo, Hanna, Isaias, Josephine, Kyle, Leah, Marco, Nana, Omar, Paulette, Rene, Sally, Teddy, Vicky, Wilfred.
  • The Atlantic hurricane season runs from June 1 to November 30.
  • The Saffir-Simpson scale runs from 75 miles per hour to 200 miles per hour.

item.title: Memorial Day Ribs 2026
item.dc:creator: chris
item.content:encoded:
It's that time of year kids: time for bbq ribs on Memorial Day! This year it's subduded and K.I.S.S.: 2 racks of St. Louis style ribs, Barbie's famous potato salad, Green Giant Corn-on-the-Cob Mini-Ears of corn, and watermellon for dessert.

Meat

  • 2 racks St. Louis style baby back ribs

Rub & Sauce

  • This year I tried Famous Dave's Rib Rub
  • Sweet Baby Ray's bbq sauce

Sides

  • Potato salad
  • Green Giant Mini-Ears of corn

Dessert

  • Watermellon

Directions

  • For the ribs, I removed the membranes from both racks, painted them with mustard, sprinked them with Dave's dust, and put them in a 250 F oven for 2 hours - uncovered.
  • Then, I painted them with Sweet Baby Ray's bbq sauce, and baked them for an additional 2 hours - covered in heavy-duty aluminum foil.

Results

  • They came out tender and tasted really good.

item.title: SpaceX IPO Made Elon Musk First Trillionare
item.dc:creator: chris
item.content:encoded: This morning, Friday, June 12, 2026, Elon Musk became the world's first trillionaire when SpaceX shares (NASDAQ: SPCX) soared on their stock market debut. The initial price was $150 but quickly climbed to $160 per share. With so much demand and so little supply - only 4% was going up for auction - some stock indexes changed their rules to accommodate SpaceX.

item.title: United States Semiquincentennial
item.dc:creator: chris
item.content:encoded:
July 4th, 2026, will mark the 250th anniversary of the United States Declaration of Independence - the Semiquincentennial. Happy 250th Birday America!

I remember the 200th anniversary - the Bicentannial - in 1976. We lived near Washington D. C., and we went to the Washington Monument to watch the fireworks.

There's two organizations planning this year's events for Americans to commemorate and celebrate. America 250 is a congressional commission established in 2016. Freedom 250 is a public-private organization created by Executive Order from President Trump.

Great American State Fair

Of course President Trump is throwing a shindig. He ordered the reflecting pool get a new coat of blue paint; it's already full of green algae. He had a cage built on the White House South Lawn to host "UFC Freedom 250, an MMA event held as part of the country's 250th birthday and President Trump's 80th birthday." There was supposed to be concerts, but a lot of the singers dropped out, so I think he's going solo and having a rally.

In late May, the president canceled his Freedom 250 concert series at the Kennedy Center after six of the nine musical acts canceled their appearances. The series was part of the Great American State Fair, featuring artists such as Vanilla Ice, Bret Michaels, and the surviving duo of Milli Vanilli.

Anywho, the Great American State Fair kicks off June 25, on the National Mall. It will feature pavillions of US States and Territories; several opted out from attending. It will run until July 10.

America 250 vs. Freedom 250

America250 and Freedom 250 are two separate organizations spearheading celebrations for the U.S. 250th anniversary, but they differ significantly in their origins, leadership, and event focus. [1, 2]

The Core Differences

America250

  • Origins: A bipartisan non-profit and congressional commission established by law in 2016 to plan the Semiquincentennial.
  • Focus: Historical and educational events nationwide, including localized state celebrations and "America's Block Party".
  • Funding: Backed by federal dollars allocated by Congress and private donations. [2, 3]

Freedom 250

  • Origins: Established by President Donald Trump via executive order as a public-private partnership Task Force. Trump serves as chair; Vice President JD Vance is vice chair.
  • Focus: Large-scale, high-profile spectacles in Washington, D.C., such as the Great American State Fair on the National Mall, UFC events, and World Cup Fan Zones.
  • Funding: Operates primarily as an outside fundraising arm heavily relying on private and international donations. [2]

Controversy and Public Reception

The existence of two separate entities has sparked political friction. Because the Trump administration formed a new group while an official bipartisan commission already existed, critics argue Freedom 250 is explicitly political and MAGA-aligned. For example, the Great American State Fair faced backlash and artist dropouts when musicians claimed they were misled about the event's political ties. Watchdog groups have also raised concerns over whether Freedom 250 events are selling political access in exchange for donations. [1, 2, 6, 7]

AI responses may include mistakes.

[1] https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/14/america250-versus-freedom250-what-to-know-about-the-us-semiquincentennial

[2] https://www.wbaltv.com/article/america-250-vs-freedom-250-whats-the-difference/71464058

[3] https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/trump-administration/trump-freedom-250-concert-america-250-difference-artists-cancel-rcna347573

[4] https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/15/us/politics/freedom-250-america-250.html

[5] https://www.app.com/story/news/2026/06/09/america250-vs-freedom-250-whats-the-difference-and-why-it-matters/90472436007/

[6] https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/5900978-freedom-250-bash-celebrates-america/

[7] https://www.reddit.com/r/OutOfTheLoop/...

The irony about all of this hype and buzz words - Freedom 250, America 250, Great American State Fair - is they won't age well. We'll forget about it next year.

item.title: The Cherry Spell
item.dc:creator: chris
item.content:encoded:
I did a thing...I generated a song using AI. It's not bad. It's not good, but it's not bad either.

The Cherry Spell – AI Music Generator

.

[Verse 1]
You came through the garden with rain on your coat,
A silver-eyed storm and a match in your throat.
The orchard went still when you stepped through the gate;
I bit down on laughter and offered my fate.

[Pre-Chorus]
Take your time, let the spell unwind,
One warm breath and the moon turns wine.

[Chorus]
Suck the pit from my cherry, draw the secret out,
Split my cherry like a whip with your tongue—no doubt.
Make the red fruit tremble, make the whole room spin;
I’m a spell in your hands, let the wildness in.

[Verse 2]
Black roses leaned close as you circled my chair,
Your grin had a kingdom of trouble to spare.
I held your gaze steady; the candles bent low,
And the orchard kept secrets it wouldn’t let go.

[Pre-Chorus]
Take your time, let the spell unwind,
One soft touch and the moon turns wine.

[Chorus]
Suck the pit from my cherry, draw the secret out,
Split my cherry like a whip with your tongue—no doubt.
Make the red fruit tremble, make the whole room spin;
I’m a spell in your hands, let the wildness in.

[Bridge]
No crown, no mercy, no morning bell,
Just your eyes and the taste of the spell.
If I say stop, then the night will cease;
If I say stay, take your time with me.

[Final Chorus]
Suck the pit from my cherry, draw the secret out,
Split my cherry like a whip with your tongue—no doubt.
Make the red fruit tremble, let the whole world spin;
I’m the storm, I’m the spell—let the wildness in.

[Outro]
The garden falls quiet, the candles burn thin;
You leave with the secret still singing within.
